description: This file provides PHP4 session management using the ADODB database wrapper library, specifically handling Oracle CLOBs for data storage. It includes functions for session handling such as open, close, read, write, destroy, and garbage collection, with configuration options for database connection and session parameters.

methods.name: adodb_sess_open
methods.description: Establishes a database connection for session management, reusing existing connection if available.

methods.name: adodb_sess_close
methods.description: Closes the database connection used for session management.

methods.name: adodb_sess_read
methods.description: Retrieves session data from the database for a given session key.

methods.name: adodb_sess_write
methods.description: Writes session data to the database, updating expiry and handling LOBs if configured.

methods.name: adodb_sess_destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data from the database for a given session key, optionally triggering expiration notifications.

methods.name: adodb_sess_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by removing expired sessions and optionally optimizing the session table.
